changelog:
**Improved credential management and test organization for ms-todo-oauth.**

- Added robust credential precedence: CLI > environment variables > built-in fallback.
- Rewrote credential/security documentation in SKILL.md with guidance for replacing and securing OAuth client secrets.
- Increased test coverage (now 33 automated tests); all tests consolidated under scripts/, manual/non-automated test files removed.
- All references updated to use the current test runner location and remove references to deleted files.
- General doc improvements: clarified setup, security, dependency, and installation instructions.
summary: Manage Microsoft To Do lists and tasks through a local Python CLI backed by Microsoft Graph OAuth. Use when an agent needs to inspect, add, complete, delete,...
